contract.rendering: deterministic SVG fragment; no DOM, network, timers, random values or external assets
contract.runtimeDiscovery: MedicalMotionParts.discover(id) returns sources, limitations, attachments, bounds, dependencies, parameterSchema and stateSchema.
contract.composition: MedicalMotionParts.createRenderer(context) supplies explicit render context to independent parts.
contract.requestRule: Search catalog and scene source first. For an explicit count, add exactly that many new component IDs and verify against the starting inventory; renderBatch count alone is insufficient.

parts.title: Coccus bacterium
parts.description: A rounded bacterial cell silhouette for morphology scenes.
parts.limitations: Shape-only schematic; not a species or staining claim.

parts.title: Bacillus bacterium
parts.description: A rod-shaped bacterial cell silhouette.
parts.limitations: Shape-only schematic; dimensions, spores and motility are omitted.

parts.title: Spirillum bacterium
parts.description: A curved spiral bacterial cell silhouette.
parts.limitations: Shape-only schematic; flagella and species identity are not represented.

parts.title: Animal cell
parts.description: A compact animal-cell silhouette with membrane, nucleus and organelles.
parts.limitations: Selected organelles are illustrative and not to scale.

parts.title: Nucleus
parts.description: A nucleus with envelope, nucleolus and chromatin marks.
parts.limitations: Nuclear organization is schematic and not a microscopy reconstruction.

parts.title: Mitochondrion
parts.description: An elongated mitochondrion with folded inner membrane.
parts.limitations: Cristae and membrane spaces are simplified; no ATP rate is implied.

parts.title: Epithelial cell
parts.description: A polarized epithelial cell with an apical surface and basal edge.
parts.limitations: Generic cell silhouette; tissue-specific junctions and polarity markers are omitted.

parts.title: Cell membrane
parts.description: A phospholipid-bilayer fragment with hydrophilic heads and hydrophobic core.
parts.limitations: Molecular arrangement is conceptual and not a molecular-scale drawing.

parts.title: DNA double helix
parts.description: A compact DNA helix with paired bases.
parts.limitations: Base sequence and molecular dimensions are not encoded.

parts.title: Neuron
parts.description: A neuron with soma, dendrites and a myelinated axon path.
parts.limitations: Signal direction is illustrative; no electrophysiology is calculated.

parts.title: Red blood cell
parts.description: A biconcave red-cell silhouette.
parts.limitations: No cell count, oxygen saturation or disease state is represented.

parts.title: White blood cell
parts.description: A leukocyte with a lobed nucleus.
parts.limitations: Generic leukocyte; lineage and activation state are not identified.

parts.title: Alveolar cluster
parts.description: A cluster of ten lobulated alveolar air spaces wrapped by a thin capillary mesh.
parts.limitations: Conceptual ten-space cluster; individual cell layers, surface area, diffusion rates and ventilation-perfusion relationships are not calculated.

parts.title: Artery cross-section
parts.description: A simplified vessel cross-section with wall layers and lumen.
parts.limitations: Wall layers are simplified and not a histological diagnosis.

parts.title: Membrane receptor
parts.description: A receptor embedded in a membrane with an external binding site.
parts.limitations: Binding and downstream signaling are generic and not pathway-specific.

parts.title: Chemical synapse
parts.description: A presynaptic terminal, cleft and postsynaptic receptors.
parts.limitations: Release and receptor response are schematic; no transmitter concentration is implied.

parts.title: Bone cross-section
parts.description: A compact bone fragment with a simplified trabecular pattern.
parts.limitations: Generic bone texture; cortical and cancellous regions are not separated.

parts.title: Scalpel
parts.description: A simple scalpel silhouette for procedural illustrations.
parts.limitations: Generic instrument silhouette; no manufacturer or size is represented.

parts.title: Syringe
parts.description: A syringe with barrel, plunger and needle.
parts.limitations: No medication, dose or route is shown.

parts.title: Suture and needle
parts.description: A curved surgical needle with thread for wound-closure scenes.
parts.limitations: Closure technique, tissue tension and material properties are not represented.

parts.title: Pituitary gland
parts.description: A compact pituitary gland silhouette with anterior and posterior lobes and a stalk.
parts.limitations: Gross-anatomy schematic; lobes, vascular connections and hormone pathways are simplified.

parts.title: Clavicle
parts.description: An S-shaped clavicle silhouette with enlarged sternal and acromial ends.
parts.limitations: Single-bone gross-anatomy schematic; side, landmarks and fracture patterns are not represented.

parts.title: Trachea
parts.description: A tracheal tube with cartilage rings and a simplified bifurcation into main bronchi.
parts.limitations: Airway schematic; cartilage composition, mucosa, dimensions and airflow are not to scale.

parts.title: Thyroid gland
parts.description: A butterfly-shaped thyroid silhouette wrapped around a short tracheal segment.
parts.limitations: Gross-anatomy schematic; lobe proportions, isthmus thickness and parathyroids are not shown to scale.

parts.title: Brainstem
parts.description: A simplified brainstem with midbrain, pons, medulla and a cerebellar contour.
parts.limitations: Orientation and nuclei are simplified; this is a gross educational silhouette, not a neuroanatomy atlas.

parts.title: Longitudinal vessel segment
parts.description: A configurable artery, vein or capillary segment with named attachments and optional valve.
parts.limitations: Longitudinal educational schematic; wall layers, pressure, velocity and histology are not to scale.

valve.description: Show a venous valve leaf pair.

parts.title: Path-based blood flow
parts.description: Reusable deterministic red-cell particles moving along a supplied polyline.
parts.limitations: Particles illustrate direction and continuity only; no blood velocity, viscosity or cell deformability is calculated.

parts.title: Attachment-aware arrow
parts.description: An arrow connecting named attachment points in a composed scene.
parts.limitations: Annotation geometry communicates a declared relationship; it does not infer anatomy or causality.

parts.title: Attachment-aware label
parts.description: A concise label placed beside a named attachment point.
parts.limitations: Label placement is schematic and does not encode a measured anatomical landmark.

parts.title: Platelet
parts.description: A small activated platelet silhouette with granule marks.
parts.limitations: Generic platelet icon; activation state and granule contents are not quantified.

parts.title: Fibrin mesh
parts.description: A reusable cross-linked fibrin network whose density follows deterministic progress.
parts.limitations: Network topology is illustrative; clot strength, factor concentrations and lysis are omitted.

parts.title: Layered tissue
parts.description: Three distinct tissue layers with named attachment edges for wound scenes.
parts.limitations: Generic educational layers; cell types, thickness and histological diagnosis are not represented.

parts.title: Fibroblast
parts.description: A spindle-shaped fibroblast with a central nucleus for repair compositions.
parts.limitations: Cell silhouette only; collagen synthesis rate and lineage are not represented.

parts.title: Macrophage
parts.description: An irregular macrophage silhouette with pseudopods for an inflammation scene.
parts.limitations: Generic immune-cell silhouette; polarization, cytokines and phagocytic rate are not represented.

parts.title: Plaque overlay
parts.description: A configurable plaque shelf that narrows a vessel lumen without replacing vessel geometry.
parts.limitations: Conceptual overlay; composition, calcification, rupture and clinical risk are not represented.

parts.title: Heart schematic
parts.description: A compact four-chamber heart with great-vessel attachment points.
parts.limitations: Schematic heart only; chamber volumes, valves, coronary anatomy and electrical timing are omitted.

parts.title: Nephron schematic
parts.description: A nephron loop with glomerulus, tubule, loop and collecting duct attachments.
parts.limitations: Schematic nephron; filtration, reabsorption, secretion and concentration are not calculated.
